title: Help shape ConquerCourse
intro: Tell us about the moments you remember, and what you wish the game could do next. No sign-in or names. Please do not include personal information.

questions.text: Which parts did you try? Tick all that you used.
options: Running and jumping on a course
Fix it or the design partner

questions.text: Think of one moment that felt great. Where were you (which course, place or tool), what did you do, and how did it feel?
Think of one moment you got stuck, confused or annoyed. Where were you, what did you try, and what did you expect to happen?
What did the game do that you did not expect, good or bad? Point to where it happened.
Did you notice or learn something about how the world works (movement, energy, maps, buildings, anything)? Point to the moment that showed you. If nothing did, what would have helped?
What do you wish you could do that you cannot yet: a move, an object, a place, a tool, a lesson? Describe it as if it were already in the game.
If you could bring one real thing into the game (a place near you, an object, an experiment, a toy), what would it be, and what would the course look like?
Where would you want to use this (at home, in class, with friends)? What would make it work there?
Anything else you want us to know?
